method: one mutation at a time; each anchor asserted to occur exactly once (LF text); the bound tests of the mutated side run (backend pytest offline per PRB-002; frontend vitest --pool=threads, JSON reporter); original bytes restored after each mutation, on exit and on signals, and verified at the end; the baseline must pass first
hash_basis: sha256 of the UTF-8 text with LF line endings
